provenance: New synthetic English briefs authored for Cowabunga AI. Research questions were suggested by a private working notebook; no private lyrics, historical prompts, third-party examples or listening reports are reproduced. These are audit tasks, not generation evidence.

tasks.brief: Fast metal drums should keep moving while the singer follows a spacious, slower-feeling pulse.

references.contribution: Definition of half-time feel, not an instruction to slow every layer.
Quarter-note kick pulse.
Supplementary galloping vocabulary; model basis unspecified.
V6-native rhythmic-feel vocabulary, not independent vocal/drum control.

tasks.future_assistant_check: Keep vocal phrasing and drum movement as separate roles. Do not halve the entire tempo.
tasks.listening_question: Does the voice gain space while fast drum movement continues?

tasks.brief: Align the rhythm guitar attacks with the kick; have the bass follow the guitar figure rather than simply duplicate the kick.

references.contribution: General coordination with a groove; no specific guitar target.

tasks.brief: Give the singer a rough-edged tone with understandable words, without turning the performance into a thin continuous shout.

references.contribution: Timbre, not register or loudness.

tasks.future_assistant_check: Keep timbre, delivery, intelligibility and placement separate.
tasks.listening_question: Are words clear and tone rough without the unwanted shouted sound?
